seen.where: https://pares.cultura.gob.es/ParesBusquedas20/catalogo/description/5040064 (images 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 viewed 9 Nov 2026, zoom 10; images 4, 7, 8 fetched, 9 returned empty)
seen.extent: Key sheet (image 1) plus about 6-8 pages of dispatches in invented-symbol cipher, dated Seville, 26 May 1811 at the end of image 3; solid symbol lines on every page, some hundreds of signs per page.
seen.cipher: Image 1: alphabet table (A, B/V/U, C/S/Z, D ... one geometric sign per letter, case and similar letters merged) plus 15 nomenclator symbols (Napoleon, King Jose, Massena, Victor, Mortier, Soult etc, Seville, Puerto de Santa Maria, Chiclana). Images 2, 3, 5, 6 carry the symbol cipher with a contemporary interlinear plaintext in Spanish written in ink above every line (e.g. image 2 begins 'ha reunido sobre veinte mil hombres de toda arma', image 6 'mandado sacar de la Isla...'). The dispatches are therefore already deciphered on the leaves; the symbols on images 2-6 are the same family as the key sheet, so they are readable with it. Lead text 'no interlinear plaintext' was wrong. Not decoded in full.
